name: DUMBBELL SINGLE LEG DEADLIFT RIGHT
introduce:
Stand on your right leg with your knee slightly bent. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. 

Hinge forward, reach the dumbbells to the floor and stretch your left leg into the air. 

Go back to the standing position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your back straight during the exercise.
Drive through your heel to go up.
Squeeze your glutes as you get up.
This is a great exercise for your glutes.
